create_diag_gaussian_distribution: create a DiagGaussian module that maps input features to a diagonal Gaussian distribution for action sampling
use_fixed_normal_log_probs: use FixedNormal.log_probs to compute summed log probabilities of actions under a Normal distribution
use_fixed_normal_entropy: use FixedNormal.entropy to compute the summed entropy of a Normal distribution across the last dimension
use_fixed_normal_mode: use FixedNormal.mode to get the mean as the mode of a Normal distribution
build_gaussian_action_head: build a DiagGaussian action head with a linear layer for mean and AddBias for log standard deviation
